1.w: And [on] His having come down from the mountain, many crowds followed Him.

2.w: And behold, a leper, having come, was kneeling down to Him, saying, “Lord, if You are willing, You are able to cleanse me.”

3.w: And having stretched out the hand, He touched him, saying, “I am willing; be cleansed!” And immediately his leprosy was cleansed.

4.w: And Jesus says to him, “See that you tell no one. But go, show yourself to the priest, and offer the gift that Moses commanded, for a testimony to them.”

5.w: And [on] His having entered into Capernaum, a centurion came to Him, imploring Him

6.w: and saying, “Lord, my servant is laid in the house a paralytic, terribly tormented.”

7.w: And He says to him, “I, having gone, will heal him.”

8.w: But answering, the centurion said, “Lord, I am not fit that You should enter under my roof; but only say a word, and my servant will be healed.

9.w: For I also am a man under authority, having soldiers under me. And I say to this one, ‘Go,’ and he goes; and to another, ‘Come,’ and he comes; and to my servant, ‘Do this,’ and he does.”

10.w: And having heard, Jesus marveled and said to those following, “Truly I say to you⁺, with no one in Israel did I find such great faith.

11.w: And I say to you⁺ that many will come from east and west and will recline with Abraham and Isaac and Jacob in the kingdom of the heavens.

12.w: But the sons of the kingdom will be cast out into the outer darkness—there will be weeping and gnashing of the teeth.”

13.w: And Jesus said to the centurion, “Go! As you believed, let it be to you.” And his servant was healed in that very hour.

14.w: And Jesus, having come to the house of Peter, saw his mother-in-law laid and having a fever.

15.w: And He touched her hand, and the fever left her; and she arose and was serving Him.

16.w: And evening having come, they brought to Him many being possessed by demons, and He cast out the spirits with a word and healed all those being ill,

17.w: so that it might be fulfilled, that having been spoken through Isaiah the prophet, saying: “He Himself took our infirmities, and carried the diseases.”

18.w: And Jesus, having seen a great crowd around Him, commanded to go away to the other side.

19.w: And having come, one scribe said to Him, “Teacher, I will follow You wherever You may go.”

20.w: And Jesus says to him, “The foxes have holes, and the birds of the air nests, but the Son of Man has nowhere He might lay the head.”

21.w: And another of His disciples said to Him, “Lord, allow me first to go away and to bury my father.”

22.w: But Jesus says to him, “Follow Me, and leave the dead to bury their own dead.”

23.w: And [on] His having entered into the boat, His disciples followed Him.

24.w: And behold, a great storm arose in the sea, so that the boat was being covered by the waves; but He Himself was sleeping.

25.w: And having come, they awoke Him, saying, “Lord, save us! We are perishing!”

26.w: And He says to them, “Why are you⁺ cowardly, O little of faith?” Then, having arisen, He rebuked the winds and the sea, and there was a great calm.

27.w: And the men marveled, saying, “What kind is this, that even the winds and the sea obey Him?”

28.w: And [on] His having come to the other side, to the region of the Gadarenes, two [men] being possessed by demons met Him, coming out of the tombs, extremely violent, so as for no one to have strength to pass by that way.

29.w: And behold, they cried out, saying, “What to us and to You, Son of God? Did You come here to torment us before the time?”

30.w: Now there was far off from them a herd of many pigs feeding.

31.w: And the demons were imploring Him, saying, “If You cast us out, send us away into the herd of pigs.”

32.w: And He said to them, “Go!” And having gone out, they went away into the pigs, and behold, all the herd rushed down the steep bank into the sea and died in the waters.

33.w: And those feeding [them] fled, and having gone away into the city, they related everything, and the [matter] of those being possessed by demons.

34.w: And behold, all the city went out to meet Jesus. And having seen Him, they implored [Him] that He might depart from their borders.
